game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut, a herbalist's hut: the beast tamer must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Squad Marcher: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job.
theme: Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut: a herbalist's hut
core_gameplay_loop: In Herbalist Hut, repeat each round: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job. Each round, giant beetles strike the root gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the squad_ready value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the root gate from giant beetles in Herbalist Hut: keep the squad_ready meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: squad_ready drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Squad Marcher
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how squad_ready changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Herbalist Hut.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while squad_ready > 0.
